# type: tile
# size: 16x16
# light: upper-left
# map: g=grass_base a=grass_hi s=grass_shadow
# map: h=water_hi w=water_base d=water_shadow
#
# The first version of river_v, kept as a regression fixture.
#
# The shading rule was "water touching a bank takes the shadow tone", and the
# generator treated everything outside the tile as not-water. So row 0 and row
# 15 were shaded as if the river ended at the tile edge. Stacked, that puts two
# dark rows together and draws a band across every seam.
#
# It passes validate.py and check_colors.py, and looks correct on its own.
